When Bobo released, he was a game-changer for high-level Titan hits. Players chased him specifically to break damage records on Red Titans (and even off-color ones). He was also a menace in Rush Attack tournaments.
Power creep has been unkind to the clown. His survivability is now his biggest liability. He risks dying to slash attacks before he can even charge his slow mana.
He is too slow and too squishy.
The -60% defense down is still "best in class" territory. However, you must protect him with items (Time Stops, Mana Potions) or defensive supports, because a high-level Titan can one-shot him.

Bobo is a relic of a different time, but unlike many of his peers, he hasn't been completely forgotten. His -60% defense down keeps him employed in the niche world of Titan slaying. He’s like that old, rusty chainsaw in your garage—it’s heavy, loud, and dangerous to use, but when you need to cut down a massive tree (or Titan), nothing else quite does the job the same way.
Keep him for Titans, bench him for everything else.
